value.rationale: Rule 54 is a canonical nonlinear elementary automaton whose glider-rich behavior motivates quantitative information survival. A sharp length-nine observational onset despite a strict global spatial-entropy drop demonstrates a genuine separation between short-block detection and asymptotic image complexity. The four exact newly missing blocks, algebraic Perron polynomial and numerical entropy gap are non-implied natural invariants of a concrete dynamically meaningful second image. This is not a minor change to a one-step table or an arbitrary slice: it isolates when a second update first becomes visible and how substantially the spatial language thins.
